dex.entry: A small, plump kin whose tail spins like a weathervane in wind; the rotation charges a static field around its body and it uses that stored charge to jam opponents' moves. A living windmill with a static personality — every time it spins faster, sparks fly.

art.silhouette: Chubby oval body, stubby limbs, a broad four-blade tail that spins freely, grey-blue fur with yellow static-spark highlights at the vane tips; cute windmill shape at 32px.
